description: Stage entry point called by orchestration. Reads games_enriched and game_tags, writes analysis_results rows of type opportunity_matrix, tag_summary, tag_clusters, tag_trends and competition_density.
signature: def run_analysis(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, params: AnalysisParams, *, parameters_version: str, on_event: EventSink) -> AnalysisReport
docstring:
Run the full analysis stage for one run.

Args:
    conn: An open storage connection.
    run_id: The run to analyze; enrichment must have already completed.
    params: AnalysisParams.
    parameters_version: Stamped onto every written analysis_results row.
    on_event: Progress/log sink.

Returns:
    An AnalysisReport summarizing the stage.

Steps:
    1. frame = storage.read_enriched(conn, run_id); tags = storage.read_tags(conn, run_id, min_votes=params.min_tag_votes).
    2. buildable, simplicity_rejected = apply_simplicity_filter(frame, params).
    3. cluster_result = cluster_tags(tags, frame, params); storage.write_analysis_result(..., 'tag_clusters', ...).
    4. demand = compute_demand(frame, cluster_result.assignments, params); competition = compute_competition_density(frame, cluster_result.assignments, params); simplicity = <median complexity per cluster, computed here by joining frame's complexity_score through cluster_result.assignments>.
    5. matrix = build_opportunity_matrix(demand, competition, simplicity, params); storage.write_analysis_result(..., 'opportunity_matrix', ...); storage.write_analysis_result(..., 'competition_density', ...).
    6. trends = compute_tag_trends(frame, cluster_result.assignments, params); storage.write_analysis_result(..., 'tag_trends', ...).
    7. tag_summary = build_tag_summary(frame, tags, params); storage.write_analysis_result(..., 'tag_summary', ...).
    8. Assemble and return AnalysisReport, emit 'stage_complete'.

Raises:
    AnalysisError: If run_id does not exist or games_enriched has zero rows for run_id and enrichment's own report indicates it should not be empty (distinguishing a legitimately empty candidate set, which is not an error, from enrichment never having run at all, which is) -- the distinguishing check is storage.get_run(run_id) plus checking for a prior 'enrichment' stage_complete run_event, per this spec's own resolution of an otherwise ambiguous case.
preconditions: enrichment has completed for run_id (games_enriched may legitimately be empty if the candidate set itself was empty, per the module's own edge case, but enrichment's stage_complete event must have been emitted at some point for this run)
postconditions: All five analysis_types (opportunity_matrix, tag_summary, tag_clusters, tag_trends, competition_density) have a row in analysis_results for run_id after a successful call, even if some are empty-but-well-formed for a tiny/empty candidate set, per the module's own edge case
Re-running run_analysis for the same run_id after a threshold change replaces the prior analysis_results rows (write_analysis_result's own replace-on-same-key semantics)

edge_cases.input: Candidate set smaller than min_cluster_size entirely
edge_cases.expected_behavior: stage succeeds, writes empty-but-well-formed results with an explanatory warning event, per the module's own edge case; AnalysisReport.scored_cluster_count == 0

edge_cases.input: Enrichment has never run for run_id (games_enriched table has no rows AND no enrichment stage_complete event exists)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: AnalysisError, distinct from the legitimately-empty-candidate-set case above

edge_cases.input: cluster_tags falls back to its run-local threshold search (pre-freeze run 1)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: run_analysis emits an explicit 'info' event noting the threshold is provisional and will be superseded once scripts/freeze_empirical_parameters.py runs, so this is visible in the run log rather than silently baked into the stored tag_clusters result with no indication of its provisional status
